Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified the film "I Know What You Did Last Summer" as the 1997 American mystery crime film starring Johnny Galecki. This is a factual error; Johnny Galecki did not star in that film. The search results visible in the viewport actually listed "Suicide Kings" (a 1997 crime thriller/comedy featuring Galecki) and other results, but the agent hallucinated or misinterpreted the data to claim "I Know What You Did Last Summer" was the answer. This initial misidentification propagated through the conversation, causing the Planner to waste multiple steps trying to verify a false premise before eventually correcting course to "Suicide Kings."
